#CVSPartner  Potty Training has officially started in our house!! I used this sticker chart system with my nanny kid and it worked really well, so I’m hopeful it will work for my kiddo too! @cvspharmacy had everything we needed at a great low price. I was also able to pick up a few household essentials when I was there too! 

Let me know if you have any fun ways to potty train that worked for your kid- in case this turns into an epic fail! 

#HealthierHappensTogether #PottyTraining #momlife #cvspartner

body.text:
This is your sign to get treated today in 3 simple steps – all from the comfort of your home.

🧑‍💻 Take a quick virtual evaluation
👨‍⚕️ Connect with a board-certified dermatologist in less than 48 hours
💊 Get prescriptions (50% less than your local pharmacy*) delivered right to your door
🧍‍♀️ No more waiting months for a PCP referral
💵 Get treated at 1/4 the cost (traditional costs are $400+!), no insurance required

Join thousands of customers who are finally getting clear in months. See what they have to say:

"⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ So much easier + quicker than going through the in-person experience. This is my 2nd time going on Accutane, and I love how everything is organized in the online portal. Pills were also much cheaper than my local CVS and I was even able to get BC directly from my Clear physician!" –Jackie

"⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ It's a great and cheap way to get one of the most expensive treatments for acne out there. They really go out of their way to answer any questions you may have or address any concerns. The doctor too is readily available. Trust me. It changed my life" –Sanjana D

"⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Super responsive customer support! The experience has been great for my daughter and so much easier than waiting months and months to see a dermatologist in person" –Erica D

---

*Actual price will vary depending on the treatment plan. Prescription products require an evaluation by a board-certified dermatologist. See website for important details and safety information.

**Eligible patients may be prescribed Accutane branded generic Isotretinoin or its bio-equivalent generic versions depending on pharmacy selection, insurance coverage, and pharmacy stock. The physician overseeing treatment will determine which medications (or substitutions) may be most appropriate.

***All patients who are prescribed treatment by a provider will be required to enroll in the FDA’s iPledge program and abide by monthly guidelines in order to proceed with treatment.
